- `LeafT::SIZE`: The number of voxels in a leaf node [S1, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly contains the line `std::memcpy(leafData, data + leafBaseOffset, LeafT::SIZE * sizeof(ValueT));`. In this context, `LeafT::SIZE` is used as the count of elements (voxels) being copied from the source data array to the leaf buffer. Since the data type is `ValueT`, multiplying `LeafT::SIZE` by `sizeof(ValueT)` gives the total byte size. Therefore, `LeafT::SIZE` represents the number of voxels in the leaf node.
